description: This file contains unit tests for the JsonCollectors class in the org.eclipse.ditto.json package. It tests various collection operations like transforming JSON objects and arrays, ensuring immutability, and combining JSON objects.

classes.name: JsonCollectorsTest
classes.description: A final class containing unit tests for JsonCollectors utility methods in the org.eclipse.ditto.json package.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that the JsonCollectors class is immutable.

methods.name: collectingFieldsOfObjectReturnsEqualObject
methods.description: Verifies that collecting the fields of a JSON object results in an object equal to the original.

methods.name: collectingFieldKeysOfObjectReturnsExpectedArray
methods.description: Checks that the keys of JSON fields are correctly collected into an array.

methods.name: collectingFieldValuesOfObjectReturnsExpectedArray
methods.description: Verifies that the values of JSON fields are correctly collected into an array.

methods.name: collectingValuesOfArrayReturnsEqualArray
methods.description: Ensures that collecting values from a JSON array returns an array identical to the original.

methods.name: collectingObjectsReturnsExpectedObject
methods.description: Tests that collecting multiple JSON objects results in a combined object with all entries.
